patch_description: Crossover of the two approaches: keep the fast vectorized softmin-annealed Adam gradient ascent (from script 2 / current program) as the main optimizer, but replace its purely random initialization with the perturbed triangular-lattice seeds from script 3 (which scored best, 0.55). After each Adam run, apply the deterministic multi-direction local polish (from script 3) but only on the bottleneck point(s) to keep it cheap (inspired by script 1's bottleneck-focused polish). Multi-start over a few lattice seeds, keep the best exact min-area configuration, with a guaranteed feasible lattice fallback. This should match or beat 0.55 combined score at lower runtime than the 2.67s pure local-search version.
